intent: Land the DOCUMENTATION output of the holon-consolidation workflow: the persistent-agent index that fulfils the P0 task filed 2026-05-28 (docs/agent_tasks/hermes_full_persistent_agent_index_2026-05-28.md, whose required report at docs/reports/hermes_persistent_agent_index_2026-05-28.md was never written), the PersistentAgentDescriptor schema it asked for, and the verified facade-to-real-body consolidation plan. DOCS ONLY: no code moves, no runtime module touched, no gate altered. All three artifacts came back FLAWED from adversarial verification and each carries an errata block naming its own verified-false claims, so they land as verified-partial working documents rather than as truth. The consolidation plan records the finding that matters: the originally proposed move ordering breaks the repo at step 1 because dharma_swarm/holon_system/runtime/__init__.py:3-4 eagerly imports .bridge and .wake_cycle while runtime/wake_cycle.py:3 imports back out to dharma_swarm.holon_runtime; a lazy PEP-562 __init__ is a mandatory MOVE 0 prerequisite. Surface-ownership check at e1c5dff: docs/reports/**, docs/architecture/PERSISTENT_AGENT_DESCRIPTOR.md and docs/plans/HOLON_CONSOLIDATION_PLAN_2026-08-01.md match no owns: glob of any of the 10 active tracks. Two supporting edits were required by the DocOps canonical guard, which stays STRICT on PRs: the descriptor doc cites real code that contains the word 'canonical' (e.g. dharma_swarm/holon_system/identity/canonical_names.py), so the substring guard demands registration. It is registered in docs/governance/CANONICAL_DOC_STACK.md and docs/docops/assertions.yaml as a DRAFT PROPOSAL that owns nothing and defers to code for every live fact — not as an authority. Both files were ownership-checked against ACTIVE_TRACK.yaml and are unowned.

commit.message: docs(holon): persistent-agent index, descriptor schema, verified consolidation plan

interface_mismatches: HOLON_RUNTIME_FULL_ESTATE_MAP.md:332 states holon_system/ is 43 files / ~360 lines; it is 47 files / 1345 lines. The plan records the correction.

HOLON_RUNTIME_FULL_ESTATE_MAP.md:333-334 states there are no production consumers outside the facade; sarathi_wake_daemon.py:81,85,86 and sarathi_proof_window.py:43-55 import holon_system.sarathi.* and sarathi-wake-lane.yml:152,160 runs them under bare python3.
HOLON_RUNTIME_FULL_ESTATE_MAP.md:344 lists Codex AND Fugu semantic responders as absent; codex_composer_semantic_responder.py is present (1411 lines). Only the Fugu half is still true.
honest_blockers: All three artifacts FAILED adversarial verification and land with errata rather than corrected. The index misses browser_agent.py (719L), synthesis_agent.py (323L, production importers), sleep_time_agent.py (606L), the 2312-line cron subsystem, garden_daemon.py, and a sixth registry at docs/ops/FLEET_FIELD_REGISTRY.yaml.
No move has been executed and none should be until MOVE 0 (lazy runtime/__init__.py) lands and the suite is proven back at baseline.
Phase C (the four a2a scripts) is deferred: its packaging-inversion justification is false because all four bodies import from scripts/ themselves.
This lands on the PR-S6 branch because the session is scoped to a single branch. It is unrelated to the wake lane and would be cleaner as its own PR.

DocOps count assertions and the AUTO_INVENTORY auto-section go stale when markdown is added; on PRs these are advisory (--counts-advisory) and docops-reconcile-main.yml reconciles them post-merge. Verified: main already carried this drift before this branch.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the three docs and this packet together. Nothing imports them; no code changed.
